sequential.interpretation: Endpoint agreement does not imply identical unrestricted continuation. This diagnostic creates no additional acceptance rule; exact replay must compare each representation with its own recorded outputs.

interpretation: Merged-model rows remain null until a merged-development receipt exists. Adapter observations cannot fill stored-model rows. main.scope: Exposure fractions sum tokens across completed steps. Mean objective weights average each category's token fraction within each separately normalized effective batch; they need not equal global token fractions. Neither quantity measures its share of parameter-gradient influence.
